title: Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka Part 2

thread.title: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle • Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka - Episode 18 discussion

opinions.point: Many viewers enjoyed the episode’s character interactions, especially the playful chemistry and mutual support between the central pair and the renewed presence of other girls.
The developing sports-related drama was viewed as compelling, with several commenters eager to learn more about the protagonist’s unresolved past.
Several commenters considered it one of the stronger episodes of the cour and praised the focus on Haru and the supporting cast.
Some viewers felt the earlier arc spent too long isolating the protagonist from the broader cast, while others preferred the current ensemble balance.
A recurring criticism was that the baseball-related mystery remains stretched out without enough resolution, making parts of the storyline feel repetitive.
Haru’s rivalry setup generated enthusiasm, but commenters also expressed concern that her self-worth is too tied to the outcome.

notes: The thread is titled Episode 18 because r/anime uses overall-series numbering; its post body explicitly lists Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka 2nd Cour and Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Part 2 as alternate titles. title: Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston

thread.title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden • Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Kamigoroshi no Bujin no Karei naru Musouroku - Episode 6 discussion

opinions.point: Many commenters enjoyed Nia’s exaggerated battle-loving personality and her comedic reactions.
The Nia–Lynokis dynamic and their arguments were repeatedly praised as entertaining.
Neal’s character development and the supportive sibling-like relationship around him received favorable attention.
Several commenters found the episode’s fights enjoyable, especially the choreography and comedic impact.
The ending theme was specifically praised by multiple commenters.
Some viewers enjoyed the tournament, while others were disappointed that it was less intense than expected.
A few commenters liked the episode’s humor and relaxed moments but felt the show’s premise promises more frequent serious fighting.
One recurring criticism was that Nia did not get a sufficiently challenging opponent.

notes: The title and metadata explicitly identify Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston and episode 6. Sentiment is paraphrased and spoiler-free; only this Reddit thread was used.
